question: The system of scientific naming or nomenclature of organism which we use today was introduced by which of the following scientists?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carolus Linnaeus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Carolus Linnaeus, also known as Carl Linnaeus, was a Swedish botanist, physician, and zoologist who formalized the modern system of naming organisms called binomial nomenclature.
 
• Linnaeus is often referred to as the "father of modern taxonomy" because of his significant contributions to the classification of living organisms.
